div.div: شَمَرْدَلٌ A youth, strong and hardy; and in the like sense applied to a camel: (Lth, TA:) or tall; as also ↓ شَمَرْدَلِىٌّ : (Ham pp. 728 and 789:) or a bulky camel: (IAar, TA:) or, of camels &c., (S, O, K,) the swift; (S, O;) or youthful, swift, and goodly in make: (K:) and with ة, a she-camel goodly, beautiful in make. (A 'Obeyd, S, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
